input.prompt: Review this workspace access error. Preserve the terms workspace and access request. Keep it under 140 characters, use one sentence, and do not use an exclamation mark.
input.suppliedCopy: Oops! You entered the wrong details. Click here to retry your access request for this workspace.

manualRubric: Required findings identify objective blame, generic link wording, punctuation, and recovery-action issues.
Optional findings contain only taste-based improvements and are not presented as defects.
The revision preserves workspace, access request, and the intended meaning.
The error is specific, kind, non-blaming, actionable, and free of humor.
Any apology is included only if product responsibility is established.
The revision satisfies the component, length, sentence, punctuation, and terminology constraints.
